alignment.inventory: Exact frozen objective is PARTITIVE sharing: known total and number of recipients, unknown each share. Two roundRobin demos:6 objects to3 then2 recipients. deal: k2..4,per2..4,total=k×per, finite pile picture, choices distinguish recipient count/whole/one-too-many; hint round robin, repeated-addition explanation. fair: three plates, equal per2..4 versus shuffled unequal counts, compare shares. share: pack k2..4,g=per2..4,pile=k×per, constructive allocation. story: k2/3,per2..5, fish/duckling context, distinguish subtracting recipient count from sharing. transfer: k2..4,per2..4 asks original whole from equal shares; optional reverse connection here, no new multiplication gate. roundRobin shows finite pile and one-at-a-time movement. ui.pack has per-bag buttons, undo and locked submit. engine.check pack only checks findIndex against target g: empty/short all-matching arrays can succeed by inspection; our exact dense k-field counts and conservation validator rejects these. Audit row26; COVERAGE omits share and uses stale global rev. No own family declarations and no SIMS overlay. index fills GOALS and retains audit1 revision.
